item.title: ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Songwriter EJAE Put Her Whole Heart—and Her Past—into “Golden”
item.description: “If you actually listen to it, there’s a sadness to it,” says the Grammy winner of her Oscar-nominated earworm.

item.title: Astrology in Washington, DC, and on Wall Street: Andrew Ross Sorkin and Sally Quinn Talk the Powerful and the Occult
item.description: From Nancy Reagan to Barry Goldwater, the capital’s most powerful have long turned to the occult for guidance—just as Wall Street titans did in the lead-up to the great crash of 1929. Sally Quinn speaks with Andrew Ross Sorkin about astrology and power.

item.title: Jubilee Media Helped Take Charlie Kirk Mainstream. What Do Its Video Debates Mean for the Future of Politics?
item.description: Eighteen months after the Turning Point USA founder helped the company launch its blockbuster series, Surrounded—and six months after his killing—Jubilee has never been bigger. Are its contentious videos the future of American discourse, or something darker?

item.title: Scream 7’s Dramatic Road to the Screen: An Exhaustive Timeline
item.description: Cast changes, director shake-ups, a full creative retooling—Scream 7’s journey to movie theaters has been plagued by controversy.

item.title: Milano Cortina 2026: yoga, sunsets and medals: each to their own Golden Moment
item.description: At the Olympic Winter Games in Italy, whether relaxing or celebrating, athletes and spectators were encouraged by Corona Cero to celebrate life’s golden moments

item.title: How Will Awards Season Move Forward Following the BAFTAs Slur Incident?
item.description: On Sunday, BAFTA attendee John Davidson, who has Tourette syndrome, involuntarily shouted the N-word at Sinners stars Michael B. Jordan and Delroy Lindo. This week on Little Gold Men, we dissect what happened next—and consider the effect it could have on the upcoming Oscars.

item.title: Monica Lewinsky on the Epstein Files and the Nuances of Grooming
item.description: Drawing a hard line between informed citizen and armchair voyeur.

item.title: Paul McCartney, Unfiltered: On Lennon, His Love for “Getting Stoned and Having Great Conversations,” and So Much More
item.description: On the eve of a new biographical documentary, Joe Hagan presents part one of a lengthy 2015 conversation in which the Beatle lets loose about John Lennon’s “attention-seeking quotes” in Rolling Stone, Yoko Ono (“she’s not that shrewd”), and the band’s “hugely painful” breakup, among other things.

item.title: Gwyneth Paltrow Is Auctioning Off Some of Her Wardrobe for Charity
item.description: A portion of the proceeds for “Bold Luxury: Gwyneth Paltrow Lexicon of Style & the Archival Edit,” organized by Julien’s Auctions, will be donated to World Central Kitchen.

item.title: 'Traitors' Star Colton Underwood Finally Faces His Dark 'Bachelor' Past
item.description: In 2020, Underwood’s ex, Cassie Randolph, filed a temporary restraining order against him. Now, after a wild season of The Traitors, the romantic lead turned reality villain is finally ready to talk about everything: his gameplay, facing death threats, his mindset during his dark pre-coming-out days, and whether he’s still in touch with Randolph.
